values.label: Flight
values.description: Grants the ability to fly while equipped or carried.

values.label: Night Vision
values.description: Provides night vision effect while equipped or carried.

values.label: Oxygen Supply
values.description: Supplies oxygen for underwater or low-oxygen environments.

values.label: Reach Boost
values.description: Increases the player's block interaction reach.

values.label: Step Assist
values.description: Allows the player to step up partial blocks automatically.

values.label: Tool Mode
values.description: Switches the active mode of a tool (e.g., pickaxe, shovel).
